lots.title: Provision of Fire Risk Assessments
lots.description: Draft Terms & Conditions document identifying Lot 1 of Building Services Framework 6278 between the London Borough of Bexley (the Council) and a contractor to be named, relating to the provision of Fire Risk Assessment Services. Contract period stated as 1 September 2020 to 31 August 2022, subject to extension under Clause F8. The document is the Form of Contract and General Terms & Conditions template only; Schedule 1 (Specification), Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule), Schedule 3 (Council's ITT) and Schedule 4 (Contractor's Tender) are empty section headings and carry no substantive specification content in this extraction.

evidence_anchor.anchor_text: RELATING TO THE PROVISION OF FIRE RISK ASSESSMENT SERVICES

warnings.message: Schedule 1 (Specification) appears on page 54 as a heading with no body content; no technical requirements, deliverables, performance standards, or acceptance criteria can be extracted from this document.

Schedule 2 (Pricing Schedule) appears on page 55 as a heading with no body content; this extraction intentionally does not emit pricing data and downstream pricing extraction should source a separate pricing-schedule document.

Schedule 3 (Council's Invitation to Tender) appears on page 56 as a heading with no body content; evaluation criteria and KPIs referenced in clauses F5.1 and F7 are stated to reside in Appendix E of the ITT but are not present in this document, so no evaluation criteria are emitted.
evidence_refs: page 56 section 'SCHEDULE 3 THE COUNCIL'S INVITATION TO TENDER'
page ~45 clause 'F5.1 Where any part of the Services is stated in Appendix E to the Invitation to Tender to be the subject of a specific KPI'

warnings.message: Schedule 4 (Contractor's Tender) appears on page 57 as a heading with no body content.

The WHEREAS clause A on page 2 states 'The Council wishes to secure the provision of security services' whereas the cover preamble on page 1 and notice-level lot 1 title identify the services as 'Fire Risk Assessment Services'. Treating this as an un-updated template placeholder; authoritative service scope is taken from the page 1 preamble and document title, not from clause WHEREAS A.
evidence_refs: page 1 'RELATING TO THE PROVISION OF FIRE RISK ASSESSMENT SERVICES'
page 2 WHEREAS A 'secure the provision of security services in Council Buildings'

warnings.message: No CPV codes are cited anywhere in this draft T&Cs document; CPV references must be sourced from the notice record or from the empty Schedule 3 ITT when it is supplied as a separate extraction.

No named British Standards, ISO standards, PAS standards, Regulatory Reform (Fire Safety) Order references, or other explicit technical standards appear in the extracted markdown; references of that nature would normally live in Schedule 1 (Specification) which is empty in this extraction.

Document was classified as 'technical_specification' and bound to the pdf-extraction/tender-specification overlay, but its substantive content is the Form of Contract (Part 1) plus General Terms and Conditions (Part 2) with unpopulated schedules. Reclassification to 'draft_terms_and_conditions' or 'contract_template' may produce a more honest authority signal on subsequent re-extractions.
evidence_refs: page 5 section 'PART 2 - GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS'
